INI configuration reference¶

Both modes are driven by an INI file at the repo root: Configuration_area.ini for area coverage and Configuration_ship.ini for moving-target detection. The loader (SRC/__init__.py::initialize) is strict – a required key that is missing raises, rather than falling back to a hidden default. Which sections are present is what distinguishes the two modes.

This page lists the sections and keys. Per-section physics detail lives on the module pages, linked from each section.

Note

Engine/numerical settings live in simulator_settings.yaml at the repo root, kept separate from the per-mission INI: the simulation step_size_s, the antenna-pattern angular resolution theta_resolution / phi_resolution plus the steering step counts along_track_steering_steps / across_track_steering_steps, and the TLE-fit residual weights tle_fit.position_weight_m / tle_fit.velocity_weight_m_s (available for tuning the osculating-to-SGP4 mean-element fit). It is loaded strictly – a missing file or key raises.

[COVERAGE] / [REFLECTION]¶

See Coverage, Specular reflection, and Backscatter point / BRP.

Key

Meaning

Unit

[COVERAGE].shapefile_path

Region / trajectory shapefile.

–

[COVERAGE].grid_size_meters

Coverage cell size.

m

[COVERAGE].max_bistatic_bksc_angle_deg

Near-backscatter acceptance half-angle for backscatter area coverage (swath half-width around the BRP track). Required when reflection_type = backscatter with a gridded region; finite and in (0, 90).

deg

[REFLECTION].reflection_type

"specular" or "backscatter" (both analysis modes); other values raise.

–

[REFLECTION].max_central_angle_deg

Tx-Rx geometric gate, finite and in (0, 180].

deg

[REFLECTION].max_incidence_angle_deg

BRP incidence gate (backscatter), finite and in (0, 90].

deg

[LINK BUDGET] / [OCEAN]¶

See Link budget, Delay-Doppler cell, and Ocean target.

Key

Meaning

Unit

system_losses_db / polarization_losses_db

Receiver-side losses.

dB

noise_bandwidth_hz / system_noise_temperature_k

Thermal-noise terms.

Hz, K

detection_sinr_threshold_db

Ship detection threshold.

dB

ocean_patch_integration_enabled / ocean_patch_grid_size

Patch-integrated ocean clutter.

–

delay_doppler_cell_enabled / coherent_integration_time_s

Use the first-order DDM-cell estimate as clutter area; T_coh sets its Doppler bin and the coherent sensitivity factor B*T_coh. Exact specular samples use the footprint cap.

–, s

num_incoherent_looks

Independent incoherent looks M; sqrt(M) is used as a detection-sensitivity approximation from reduced estimator variance, not as lower mean thermal noise.

–

[OCEAN].ocean_wave_height_m … ocean_inverse_wave_age

Sea state: significant wave height \(H_s\) (the roughness model uses \(\sigma_h\simeq H_s/4\)), wind speed / direction, temperature, salinity, wave age.

m, m/s, deg, degC, PSU, –
